name: Narumiya Chisa
source:
Favorite things: Her husband, cats, nature
Dislikes: Deadlines, ghosts, natto
Hobbies: Hanging out with [url=https://vndb.org/c107864]Yuuki[/url], reading
Strengths: Beauty and intelligence, honesty
Weaknesses: Too mischievous, a bit sluggish
Alcohol Tolerance: Normal (gets hungover easily)

She was Yuuki's older next-door neighbor and has always liked him. She's also a writer who mainly works on novels.

She's the rare sort of person to have actually followed through on a childhood marriage proposal.

She still has some fun at Yuuki's expense now that they're together, possibly because that's how they were when they met.

She is good at housework and her job, is very generally talented, and has a lot of income.
Perhaps that's why she "forcibly" pays for most of the living expenses.

She was worried she wouldn't get to marry Yuuki, but still stayed pure all those years. After two decades of waiting, though, her inner beast gets unleashed in bed.
